description: Works to Protected Trees (TPO No. 179 1986):T5 Sycamore corresponding to TPO tree T1 or T2 Sycamore on the frontage of Pablo Neruda CloseSection fell to as close to ground level as practicable and grind stump to 250mm below ground level. Kretzschmaria deusta fruiting bodies at base in immature stage render the tree unsustainable. Current height approx 14 metres. Current canopy spread approx 6 metres.T17 Sycamore corresponding to TPO tree T3 or T4 Sycamore on the frontage groupCrown reduction by up to 3 metres. Reduction will lower overall height from approx 15 metres to 12 metres and reduce radial spread from approx 13 metres to 10 metres on all compass points. Reduction cuts to suitable secondary growth points to maintain a balanced crown and to alleviate adaptive growth against the metal railings.Reason for works tree works:  Removal of unsustainable decayed Sycamore and cyclical management of retained Sycamore.Trees not protected by TPO No. 179:T11 Whitebeam crown reduction.T13 Whitebeam crown reduction.T14 Whitebeam crown reduction.T16 Whitebeam crown reduction.T19 Italian Alder re pollard.These trees are not covered by the Order. Consent is not required. They are recorded for information only.
